Pop Smoke mentions rival gang members from the Brownsville section of Brooklyn, specifically rival Drill rappers Tay 627 and Chris Elite, who are members of Folk Nation; who are a crew that affiliate themselves with Cho.

line: I’m from the Floss where niggas tote (Woo)
vault_lines: I'm from the Floss where niggas tote (Woo)
meaning:
Pop Smoke is from the Canarsie section of Brooklyn. also referred to as “Flossy” of “Floss”.

A term the rapper Fabolous helped make popular in his 2007 song “Brooklyn”.

Pop Smoke let’s us know people from Canarsie are ready and carry weapons.

Pop Smoke’s line here has different possible meanings.  “Coco” is slang for the drug “cocaine,” as well as the designer brand Chanel, as the original designer was named Coco Chanel.



He could also be talking about his skin color because coco is also used for chocolate. We know he’s black which is also known for chocolate.

line: Look, you cannot say Pop and forget the Smoke (Nah)
vault_lines: Look, you cannot say Pop and forget the Smoke (Nah)
meaning:
“Smoke” is a slang term used to describe a verbal or physical confrontation. Pop Smoke previously offered similar advice to his opposition on his July 2019 track, “Better Have Your Gun”:

Talk down on my name, better have your gun

The lyric itself is a play on Pop Smoke’s name. According to Famous Births and Deaths, his stage name is derived from two of his oldest monikers: “Poppa” and “Smoke Oh Guap.”
